stem.zh-CN: 在 [[term:cnn|CNN]] 中，[[term:convolution|卷积操作（Convolution）]]的特性包括？
stem.en-US: Which are characteristics of the [[term:convolution|convolution operation]] in a [[term:cnn|CNN]]?

explanation.zh-CN: B 对，局部连接可减少参数；D 对，共享卷积核的梯度要累加；A、C 错。
explanation.en-US: B is correct because local connections reduce the number of parameters; D is correct because the gradient of a shared kernel must be accumulated. A and C are incorrect.

primaryConcept.zh-CN: 卷积的局部感受野与参数共享
primaryConcept.en-US: Local receptive fields and parameter sharing in convolution

secondaryEngineeringStages.zh-CN: E0 基础机制与模型计算
secondaryEngineeringStages.en-US: E0 Foundational mechanisms and model computation

text.zh-CN: 在卷积核大小与通道数固定的情况下，卷积层参数量会随着输入特征图空间尺寸的增大而线性增长
text.en-US: With kernel size and channel count fixed, the number of convolution-layer parameters grows linearly with the spatial size of the input feature map

text.zh-CN: 卷积层通过[[term:receptive-field|局部感受野]]建立输入与输出之间的连接关系，从而显著减少参数规模
text.en-US: A convolution layer uses [[term:receptive-field|local receptive fields]] to connect inputs and outputs, significantly reducing parameter count

text.zh-CN: 卷积操作本身保证网络对输入的任意[[term:translation-equivariance|平移严格不变]]，因此无需[[term:pooling|池化]]或[[term:data-augmentation|数据增强]]
text.en-US: Convolution itself guarantees strict translation invariance for any input, so [[term:pooling|pooling]] and [[term:data-augmentation|data augmentation]] are unnecessary

text.zh-CN: 卷积操作中[[term:parameter-sharing|同一卷积核在不同空间位置复用]]，其梯度在[[term:backpropagation|反向传播]]时需要进行累加
text.en-US: A convolution reuses the same kernel at different spatial positions, so its gradient must be accumulated during [[term:backpropagation|backpropagation]]
